# TEST Backend Overview

The backend is responsible for handling all business logic that the R Shiny frontend relies on. Core responsibilities include:

- Geometry validation, buffering, and grid generation
- Chemistry data lookup
- Report creation and validation
- Asynchronous report generation (PDF)
- Permissions and user authentication
- Dataset versioning for chemistry results

This document summarizes each component and links to deeper sections.

Use the sidebar to navigate to specific topics.
